title: Artificial Neural Networks as Surrogate Models in Black Box Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.22329v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Black-Box Optimization (BBO) is often applied in several engineering fields and can utilize an advancement of numerical measure- ments and simulation technologies. It deals with the optimization func- tions, where an analytical description is unavailable. It relies on meth- ods that require only an input point in the search space, paired with its corresponding objective function value, obtained through non-analytical means, e.g., sensors, experiments, or simulations. Common approaches include evolutionary optimization and other metaheuristics. Since BBO methods rely solely on objective function values, they typically require many evaluations, which becomes problematic when evaluating the ob- jective function is time-consuming or expensive. translated_title: 人工神经网络作为黑盒优化中的代理模型
translated_abstract: 黑盒优化（BBO）常应用于多个工程领域，并能利用数值测量和仿真技术的进步。它处理的是无法获得解析描述的优化函数。它依赖于这样的方法：只需要搜索空间中的一个输入点，以及通过非解析手段（如传感器、实验或仿真）获得的对应目标函数值。常见的方法包括进化优化和其他元启发式算法。由于黑盒优化方法仅依赖目标函数值，它们通常需要大量的评估，而当评估目标函数非常耗时或成本高昂时，这就会成为问题。这促使人们采用基于代理模型的优化方法，即评估选定的真实目标值，并训练一个回归模型来近似整个搜索空间上的目标函数。代理模型……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出在黑盒优化中使用人工神经网络作为代理模型，通过回归近似目标函数来减少昂贵且耗时的真实目标函数评估次数。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using artificial neural networks as surrogate models in black-box optimization to approximate the objective function, thereby reducing the number of costly and time-consuming true objective function evaluations.
